name: DevRel Weekly Digest (weekly-digest)

nodes.name: Schedule Monday 09:00 ART
nodes.notes: Cron: 0 9 * * 1 (ART, via GENERIC_TIMEZONE). Fires Monday 09:00 ART = 12:00 UTC.

nodes.name: Run devrel-analyst weekly_digest
nodes.notes: Invokes devrel-analyst skill (AC-13) to produce the weekly digest markdown. Uses ANALYTICS_DB_URL env var for DB connection.

parameters.text:
=📊 *DevRel Weekly Digest ready*

Week: {{ $('Prepare Digest File').first().json.isoWeek }}
File: `~/sync/wiki/devrel/insights/{{ $('Prepare Digest File').first().json.filename }}`

Highlights available in the wiki digest.

nodes.name: Telegram Digest Notification
nodes.notes: Sends Telegram notification with link to the weekly digest wiki page (AC-14).

notes: Phase V Part D — AC-14. Runs Monday 09:00 ART. Invokes devrel-analyst weekly_digest skill → writes markdown to ~/sync/wiki/devrel/insights/weekly-<YYYY-WW>.md → Telegram notification. Activate after Tier 1 ingestion is running (need 7+ days of data). See docs/specs/devrel-analytics-stack.md.
